messages:
maria-docs: Quick note from a docs run-through today: the Quickstart README has a few copy/paste footguns. curl shows REDWOOD_KEY but our SDKs expect REDWOOD_API_KEY, and the Node snippet uses bare fetch which breaks in older Node runtimes. Opening a fix PR.

kai-engineer: ah ok. which folder?

maria-docs: docs/quickstart/README.md — top of page. Also added a Powershell example because folks on Windows kept pasting the curl line and getting weird header escaping.

emma-devex: awesome. can we make the README explicit about retry behavior? curl is one-shot; say "SDKs include exponential backoff, curl does not" so people don't assume parity.

sanjay-eng: agreed. suggest changing Authorization header to use $REDWOOD_API_KEY and add a short PowerShell escape example: -H 'Authorization: Bearer $env:REDWOOD_API_KEY' (or use double quotes with backticks guidance).

maria-docs: pasted the replacement Node snippet here for review:

```js
// Node (commonjs) safe example - works on Node 12+ with node-fetch@2
const fetch = require('node-fetch'); // npm i node-fetch@2
const API_KEY = process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY;

fetch('https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: {
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    'Authorization': `Bearer ${API_KEY}`
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({ prompt: 'Hello' })
})
  .then(res => res.json())
  .then(console.log)
  .catch(err => console.error('Request failed', err));
```

emma-devex: lgtm. tiny nit: include a note above codeblock about installing node-fetch and that modern Node can use global fetch so pick the snippet that matches their runtime.

sanjay-eng: could we add copy buttons to the code blocks? they reduce bad pastes a lot.

maria-docs: put that in the PR description and opened a follow-up ticket for docs UI: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/512 and #401 (docs-ui copy buttons).

deploy-bot: docs site rebuild queued (job 8937). ETA ~ 8m.

emma-devex: once deployed I'll add a one-line to the onboarding checklist so SEs point new customers at the updated quickstart during their first curl test.

kai-engineer: I'll update the internal runbook to reference the new env var name. thanks for catching this, Maria :thumbsup:

maria-docs: thanks everyone, closing once it merges.
